sprichwoerter.sub: = Those who start early get ahead.

sprichwoerter.text: Não é por muito madrugar que amanhece mais cedo.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Being early doesn't speed things up; some things take their time.

sprichwoerter.text: Mais vale tarde do que nunca.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to do it late than not at all.

sprichwoerter.text: É de pequenino que se torce o pepino.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Habits and education are formed in childhood.
= People who make a lot of noise rarely act.
= You must take a risk to gain something.

sprichwoerter.text: A pressa é inimiga da perfeição.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you hurry, you make mistakes.

sprichwoerter.text: Água mole em pedra dura, tanto bate até que fura.

sprichwoerter.sub: = A rumour usually has some truth.

sprichwoerter.text: Gato escaldado de água fria tem medo.
sprichwoerter.sub: = After a bad experience you fear even harmless things.

sprichwoerter.text: Em casa de ferreiro, espeto de pau.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The expert doesn't have what he makes for others.
